lede: Louisville carries the stronger underlying team rating — +6.9 against +2.8, a 4.2-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Syracuse +6.5 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Louisville winning 67% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is running backs, where Louisville leads Syracuse by 111 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 81% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
